feedback_use: Round 1 slightly reduced wirelength in five cells but destabilized the overflow-heavy bp_fe case, especially seed s2. This policy therefore avoids compressing congested-edge costs and attenuates its wirelength bias as die-wide pressure rises.
hypothesis: A small long-net edge scaling will favor shorter paths by increasing edge cost relative to turn cost, while modest overflow/history surcharges and die-overflow gating should reduce the seed-sensitive congestion regressions seen in round 1.
